assets.prompt: Circular emblem logo for a Brazilian wildlife fantasy RPG called NATIVA. A majestic jaguar head seen in three-quarter view, formed from interlocking stylized tropical leaves, palm fronds and glowing fireflies, eyes glowing warm gold. Surrounded by a thin ring of woven vines with tiny bromeliad flowers. Flat vector-style illustration with clean edges, limited palette of emerald green, deep forest teal, lime highlights and antique gold, centered composition on a plain very dark green background, symmetrical, high contrast, suitable as an app icon, no text, no letters, no watermark.
